tip.en: Pace disappears entirely for ~24 seconds while HR spikes from 105 to 119 — almost certainly a traffic light. Heart rate is already climbing fast for the first minute, so this involuntary pause actually helped avoid an over-eager opening.
tip.zh: 节奏在约24秒内完全消失，心率却从105骤升至119，很可能是等红灯。好在这个被迫停顿避免了开跑节奏过猛带来的心肺超负荷。

title.en: Cardiac Control on the Long Westward Ramp

tip.en: From km 1.4 to 2.1 you climbed ~18 m over 700 m at 1–3% grade; HR settled at 143–149 while pace sat around 6:30. Compare this to Catalina four days ago where the same effort zone pushed HR to 152+. The recovery is showing.
tip.zh: 从1.4km到2.1km，700米距离爬升约18米，坡度1–3%，心率稳在143–149，配速约6:30。对比四天前的Catalina 10K同等强度心率超152，说明身体恢复状态良好。

tip.en: Paces balloon to 16–18 min/km for nearly a minute around km 2.7 while HR drifts from 151 down to 135 — another traffic or pedestrian stop. The quick HR drop confirms you weren't fighting it; use these as micro-recoveries rather than frustrations.
tip.zh: 2.7km附近约一分钟内配速膨胀至16–18分/公里，心率从151降至135，再次遭遇路口等待。心率快速下降说明你处理得很放松，把这类强制停顿当作微恢复即可。

tip.en: Grade spikes to 8–9% for about 60 seconds (idx 1972–1992), lifting altitude from 25 m to 29 m. Heart rate barely responds — sitting at 148–150 — because pace was already conservative at ~6:30. Good instinct to not force it here.
tip.zh: 约60秒内坡度飙至8–9%（索引1972–1992），海拔从25米升至29米。由于配速本就保守约6:30，心率几乎没有反应，仅维持在148–150。不强行冲坡的判断是正确的。

title.en: Max HR Moment in the Technical Gully
title.zh: 技术性峡谷段的最高心率

tip.en: HR peaks at 156 here — the run's ceiling — on a 4% uphill after a series of abrupt grade changes including a -13% descent just beforehand (idx 2652–2656). The body was reacting to rapid terrain switching, not sustained load. This is 23 bpm below your recent max (179) and 10 below Catalina's 166; the terrain provoked it, not cardiovascular strain.
tip.zh: 心率在此达到全程峰值156次/分，前方刚经历了-13%的急降坡（索引2652–2656），随即遇上4%上坡，地形骤变触发了心率峰值。这比你近期最高心率（179次）低23次，比Catalina低10次，属于地形应激而非体能透支。

tip.en: From roughly idx 2708 to 2756 (~48 seconds) pace is null or 20–52 min/km and HR collapses from 155 to 130 — you stopped entirely. This is the longest pause of the run and sits right after the peak HR. Whether deliberate or forced, the HR recovery to 130 in under a minute is a healthy sign.
tip.zh: 从约索引2708到2756（约48秒），配速归零或超50分/公里，心率从155骤降至130——完全停下来了。这是全程最长停顿，恰好在心率峰值之后。无论主动还是被动，不到一分钟心率恢复至130是良好体能储备的体现。

title.en: Post-Break Scramble: Steepest Uphill of the Run

tip.en: After the long stop, you immediately hit 20–21% grade for two consecutive intervals (idx 3112–3116), altitude jumping from 9 m to 10.5 m in 8 seconds. HR climbs from 137 to 149 over the next 400 m as the body re-engages. This is the steepest uphill in the whole run and comes on cold legs — worth walking in future.
tip.zh: 长时间停顿后立刻遭遇坡度20–21%的急坡（索引3112–3116），8秒内海拔从9米升至10.5米。随后400米内心率从137回升至149，身体重新激活。这是全程最陡上坡，且发生在腿部冷却后，建议未来此处改为步行通过。

tip.en: From km 8.2 onward HR drops steadily from 130 to under 100 over 1.3 km of flat terrain at 10–12 min/km. This is a genuinely disciplined cool-down — longer and more gradual than any recent run. After back-to-back 10 km efforts (Catalina + today), this extended low-intensity tail is exactly the right recovery management.
tip.zh: 从8.2公里起，在1.3公里平路上以10–12分/公里的速度，心率从130稳步降至100以下。这是一次真正有纪律的冷却跑——比近期任何一次都更长、更渐进。在连续两次10公里（Catalina+今天）之后，这段低强度收尾是正确的恢复管理方式。
